title: Describing changes over time / Kozonga makambo oyo ezali kozonga na ntango
bridge: Na anglais, mpo na kozonga makambo oyo ezali kozonga, batiki yango na 'get', 'become' mpe 'turn' oyo na espagnol mbala nyingi batimbi yango na 'ponerse', 'hacerse' to 'volverse'. Na ndenge moko ya espagnol, anglais ezali kosalela verbes oyo ya ndenge moko te mpo na kozonga makambo; kasi, ezali kosalela verbes oyo ya ndenge moko. Na anglais, basili yango na ndakisa ya presente perfecto ('have changed') mpe passé simple ('changed'), oyo ezali kokanga na ndenge moko te na pretérito perfecto compuesto mpe pretérito indefinido ya espagnol. Bana oyo bayekolaka espagnol mbala nyingi batimbi 'estoy más cansado' na 'I am more tired' na ndenge moko te ya kozonga, kasi ndenge nionso ya kozonga ezali 'I have gotten more tired'.
rule: Mpo na kozonga makambo na anglais: 1) Salela 'get' + adjectif (to comparatif) mpo na makambo oyo ezali kozonga na ndenge ya ndenge to na ntango: 'get older', 'get better', 'get colder'. 2) Salela 'become' + adjectif/nom mpo na makambo oyo ezali kozonga na ndenge ya ndenge to na ntango: 'become a teacher', 'become famous'. 3) Salela 'turn' + couleur to adjectif mpo na makambo oyo ezali kozonga na ndenge ya ndenge to na ntango: 'turn red', 'turn pale'. 4) Mpo na makambo oyo ezali kozonga na ndenge ya ndenge to na ntango ya santé, ezali na ndakisa ya 'grow' (kozonga) mpe 'fall' (kozala) na expressions oyo ya ndenge moko: 'grow old', 'fall asleep'. 5) Na 'used to' ezali kozonga makambo oyo ezali kozonga na ntango oyo ezali kozala te: 'I used to live here'. 6) Na 'no longer' mpe 'still' ezali kozonga makambo: 'I no longer smoke', 'I still work here'. 7) Presente perfecto ezali kosalelaka makambo oyo ezali kozonga na ntango oyo ezali kozala na ndenge moko: 'The town has changed a lot'. Ezali kosalela 'ser' to 'estar' + adjectif na ndenge moko ya espagnol: 'estoy cansado' ezali 'I am tired' kasi mpo na kozonga, ezali 'I have gotten tired'.

concept_examples.text: People are getting older.
concept_examples.translation: Bato bazali kozonga na ndenge ya ndenge.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈpiːpəl ɑːr ˈɡetɪŋ ˈoʊldər/

concept_examples.text: The city has changed a lot.
concept_examples.translation: Ville ezali kozonga mingi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɪti hæz tʃeɪndʒd ə lɑːt/

concept_examples.text: She became more confident after the course.
concept_examples.translation: Ye azali kozonga na ndenge ya ndenge na nsima ya cours.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃi bɪˈkeɪm mɔːr ˈkɑːnfɪdənt ˈæftər ðə kɔːrs/

concept_examples.text: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
concept_examples.translation: Mabele bazali kozonga na jaune na automne.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə liːvz tɜːrn ˈjɛloʊ ɪn ˈɔːtəm/

common_error.wrong: I am more tired now than before.
common_error.correct: I have gotten more tired now.
common_error.correct_alt: I have become more tired now.
common_error.explanation: Likolo ezali kozala mpo na espagnol basili yango 'estoy más cansado' mpo na kozonga makambo. Kasi na anglais, 'I am tired' ezali kozala na état actuel, kozanga kozonga. Mpo na kozonga kozonga, bosalela presente perfecto na 'get' to 'become' (to 'have gotten' / 'have become'). Ezali na ndakisa ya 'I am more tired' kasi mpo na kozonga, ezali 'I have gotten more tired'. Boyoka kozonga na kozanga état to kozonga.

examples.original: It is getting colder.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈɡetɪŋ ˈkoʊldər/
examples.translation: Ezali kozanga na froid (ezali kozanga na froid).
examples.note: Salela 'get' + comparatif mpo na makambo oyo ezali kozanga na ndenge ya ndenge. Na espagnol mbala nyingi basili yango 'está haciendo' kasi na anglais ezali na ndakisa ya 'is getting'.

examples.original: My English is getting better.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz ˈɡetɪŋ ˈbɛtər/
examples.translation: Anglais na ngai ezali kozanga (ezali kozanga na ndenge).
examples.note: Na ndakisa ya 'get better' ezali kokanga na 'mejorar' na espagnol. Boyoka kozanga na 'ser mejor'.

examples.original: The days are getting longer.
examples.phonetic: /ðə deɪz ɑːr ˈɡetɪŋ ˈlɔːŋɡər/
examples.translation: Mibu ezali kozanga na long.
examples.note: Boyoka 'long' ezali na silaba moko, kasi comparatif ezali 'longer' na -er.

examples.original: He became famous after the video.
examples.phonetic: /hi bɪˈkeɪm ˈfeɪməs ˈæftər ðə ˈvɪdi.oʊ/
examples.translation: Azali kozanga na célèbre na nsima ya vidéo.
examples.note: Mpo na makambo oyo ezali kozanga na état (célèbre, riche) basalela 'become'. Na espagnol basili yango 'hacerse'.

examples.original: The situation became complicated.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən bɪˈkeɪm ˈkɑːmplɪkeɪtɪd/
examples.translation: Situation ezali kozanga na compliqué.
examples.note: Na ndakisa ya 'become complicated' ezali kokanga na 'volverse complicado'.

examples.original: She became a doctor in 2010.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi bɪˈkeɪm ə ˈdɑːktər ɪn tuː ˈθaʊzənd ˈtɛn/
examples.translation: Azali kozanga na docteur na 2010.
examples.note: Na professions to roles, basalela 'become' + nom na article te.

levels.label: Expressing changes with used to and no longer
levels.translation: Kozonga makambo na used to mpe no longer

examples.original: I used to live in Madrid.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ juːst tʊ lɪv ɪn məˈdrɪd/
examples.translation: Nazali kozala na Madrid.
examples.note: Mpo na kozonga makambo oyo ezali kozala te, basalela 'used to' + verbe base.

examples.original: I no longer eat meat.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ˈlɔːŋɡər iːt miːt/
examples.translation: Nazali kozala te na viande.
examples.note: Na espagnol basili yango 'ya no', na anglais 'no longer' ezali na ndenge moko ya formal ya 'don't... anymore'.

examples.original: She didn't use to smoke, but now she does.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi ˈdɪdnt juːst tʊ smoʊk bʌt naʊ ʃi dʌz/
examples.translation: Ye azali kozala te na fumée, kasi kaka azali.
examples.note: Na négatif basali yango 'didn't use to' (na -d te na 'use'). Boyoka pronunciation: /juːst/.

title: Speculating and making deductions / Kotsatola na kosala makomami
bridge: Na espanyol, tozali kotosa na ba 'debe de ser' to 'puede que sea'. Na anglais, tozali kosala na ba 'must', 'might', 'could', 'can't' tii na infinitif. Mokolo mobimba ezali ete 'must' ekomisi makomami ya solo (ya solo) na 'can't' ekomisi makomami ya te (ya te); 'might', 'may' na 'could' ekomisi bosongi. Boye, boye: boya kozonga 'must not' po na kosala makomami ya te, kasi na anglais 'must not' eleki kobenga.
rule: Po na kosala makomami na présent na anglais, tozali kosala na ba modal oyo elandi na forme ya base ya verbe: 'must' (makomami ya solo ete kuna ezali solo), 'can't' (makomami ya solo ete kuna ezali te), 'might', 'may', 'could' (bosongi, mawa te). Po na kozonga na sujet ya passé, tozali kosala 'must have + participe', 'can't have + participe', 'might have + participe', etc. Structure ezali: sujet + modal + verbe ya base (présent) to modal + have + participe (passé). Molongo: na espanyol, 'debe de ser' na 'no puede ser' bazali na elongo, kasi na anglais tozali kozonga 'must not be' po na kosala makomami ya te; tozali kosala 'can't be'.

concept_examples.text: He must be tired after the long trip.
concept_examples.translation: Ye debe de estar cansado después del largo viaje.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː mʌst biː ˈtaɪərd ˈæftər ðə lɔːŋ trɪp/

concept_examples.text: She can't be serious about moving to another country.
concept_examples.translation: No puede ser que hable en serio sobre mudarse a otro país.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː kænt biː ˈsɪriəs əˈbaʊt ˈmuːvɪŋ tuː əˈnʌðər ˈkʌntri/

concept_examples.text: They might have forgotten the meeting.
concept_examples.translation: Puede que hayan olvidado la reunión.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ maɪt hæv fərˈɡɒtən ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: It could rain later, so take an umbrella.
concept_examples.translation: Podría llover más tarde, así que lleva un paraguas.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt kʊd reɪn ˈleɪtər soʊ teɪk ən ʌmˈbrelə/

common_error.wrong: He must not be at home because the lights are off.
common_error.correct: He can't be at home because the lights are off.
common_error.correct_alt: He must be out because the lights are off.
common_error.explanation: Likolo ezali kosala mpo na espanyol tozali kozonga 'no debe estar' po na komonisa makomami ya te, kasi na anglais, 'must not' ekomisi kobenga ('no debe' = azali na elongo te). Po na kosala makomami ete kuna ezali te to bosongi, tozali kosala 'can't' (to 'couldn't' po na kosala ya mawa). Alternatif 'must be out' ezali ya solo mpo na esengo ezali na elongo: kosala makomami ete azali na ndako te.

examples.original: You're a journalist. You must meet a lot of people.
examples.phonetic: /jʊər ə ˈdʒɜːrnəlɪst. juː mʌst miːt ə lɒt əv ˈpiːpl/
examples.translation: Oyo ezali mobali ya presse. Debes de conocer a mucha gente.
examples.note: Tozali kosala 'must' tango tozali na boyokani ya solo mpo na kuna ezali makasi. Na espanyol, 'debe de'.

examples.original: That can't be the right answer.
examples.phonetic: /ðæt kænt biː ðə raɪt ˈænsər/
examples.translation: Oyo no puede ser la respuesta correcta.
examples.note: Tozali kosala 'can't' po na kozonga ete kuna ezali te. Na espanyol, 'no puede ser'.

examples.original: He must have a lot of money because he drives a Ferrari.
examples.phonetic: /hiː mʌst hæv ə lɒt əv ˈmʌni bɪˈkɒz hiː draɪvz ə fəˈrɑːri/
examples.translation: Debe de tener mucho dinero porque conduce un Ferrari.
examples.note: Kombo ezali kosala na 'because' (mpete) na kozua makomami.

levels.label: Possibility with might, may, and could
levels.translation: Bosongi na might, may na could

examples.original: She might be at the gym right now.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː maɪt biː æt ðə dʒɪm raɪt naʊ/
examples.translation: Puede que esté en el gimnasio ahora mismo.
examples.note: 'Might' ekomisi bosongi mawa te kolonga 'must'. Na espanyol, 'puede que'.

examples.original: They may arrive late because of the traffic.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ meɪ əˈraɪv leɪt bɪˈkɒz əv ðə ˈtræfɪk/
examples.translation: Puede que lleguen tarde debido al tráfico.
examples.note: 'May' ezali na elongo na 'might', kasi mbala mawa ezali ya mawa mpenza. Mibali mibali ezali ya solo.

examples.original: This could be the best restaurant in the city.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs kʊd biː ðə best ˈrestərɒnt ɪn ðə ˈsɪti/
examples.translation: Este podría ser el mejor restaurante de la ciudad.
examples.note: 'Could' komonisi bosongi mpe tozali kosala mpenza na makambo.

examples.original: He must have studied a lot for the exam.
examples.phonetic: /hiː mʌst hæv ˈstʌdid ə lɒt fɔːr ði ɪɡˈzæm/
examples.translation: Debe de haber estudiado mucho para el examen.
examples.note: Tozali kosala 'must have + participe' po na kosala makomami na sujet ya passé. Na espanyol, 'debe de haber'.

examples.original: She can't have seen us because she didn't wave.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː kænt hæv siːn ʌs bɪˈkɒz ʃiː dɪdnt weɪv/
examples.translation: No puede habernos visto porque no saludó.
examples.note: 'Can't have + participe' ekomisi makomami ya te na sujet ya passé. Na espanyol, 'no puede haber'.

examples.original: They might have missed the bus.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ maɪt hæv mɪst ðə bʌs/
examples.translation: Puede que hayan perdido el autobús.
examples.note: 'Might have + participe' ekomisi bosongi na sujet ya passé. Na espanyol, 'puede que hayan'.

examples.original: The roads are wet. It must have rained.
examples.phonetic: /ðə roʊdz ɑːr wet. ɪt mʌst hæv reɪnd/
examples.translation: Las carreteras están mojadas. Debe de haber llovido.
examples.note: Makasi oyo ezali (mosala ya route) ekomisi ete tozali na boyokani ya solo na sujet ya passé.

title: Expressing regret and hypothetical situations / Komona mabé oyo esalemi na kosala makambo oyo ta yango
bridge: Na español, ozali kosala ngambo ya kondisionali na subjuntivo mpo na kosala ndaku ya makambo oyo esalemi na mabé (mbala mosusu, 'si tuviera tiempo, iría'). Na anglais, lisanga ezali moke: ozali kosala ngambo ya lokola (to lokola oyo esalemi) na 'if' na 'would' + ngambo na ndaku ya mbalé. Kopesa mabé ezali mpo na kotika 'si tendría' na 'if I would have', kasi na anglais ndaku ya 'if' ta ye moko na 'would'. Kasi, mpo na kosala ndaku ya makambo oyo esalemi na lokola oyo esalemi, ozali kosala ngambo ya oyo esalemi (had + partisipio) na esika ya kondisionali oyo esalemi.
rule: Na anglais B1, mpo na komona makambo oyo esalemi to oyo ezali kolanda (kondisionali ya liboso), ozali kosala 'if + lokola' (to 'if + lokola oyo ezali kolanda') na ndaku ya kondisionali, na 'would + ngambo ya mbalé' na ndaku ya mbalé. Mbala mosusu: 'If I had more time, I would travel.' (Si tuviera más tiempo, viajaría). Nota 'were' ezali kosalema mpo na bato nionso na 'if I were' (kasi 'was' ezali ya ndenge na anglais ya ndenge). Mpo na komona mabé oyo esalemi (kondisionali ya mitano), ozali kosala 'if + oyo esalemi' (had + partisipio) na 'would have + partisipio' na mbalé: 'If I had studied, I would have passed.' (Si hubiera estudiado, habría aprobado). Ozali mpe kosala 'I wish' + oyo esalemi mpo na mabé: 'I wish I had studied.' (Ojalá hubiera estudiado). Kolinga kozua ete ndaku ya 'if' ta ye moko na 'would' to 'will'. Na makambo ya kondisionali ya ndenge, 'were' ezali kosalema: 'If he were here...'.

concept_examples.text: If I had more money, I would buy a car.
concept_examples.translation: Soki nalaki kopesa mbongo mingi, nakotí ndako ya makasi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd mɔːr ˈmʌni aɪ wʊd baɪ ə kɑːr/

concept_examples.text: I wish I knew the answer.
concept_examples.translation: Nakopesa mabé soki nayebi likambo oyo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ nuː ði ˈænsər/

concept_examples.text: If she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam.
concept_examples.translation: Soki ye alaki kosala eloko oyo mingi, alingaki kopesa eloko oyo malamu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː hæd ˈstʌdid ˈhɑːrdər ʃiː wʊd hæv pæst ði ɪɡˈzæm/

concept_examples.text: I would travel more if I were younger.
concept_examples.translation: Nakotí na ndako ya makasi soki nazali na nguya.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd ˈtrævl mɔːr ɪf aɪ wɜːr ˈjʌŋɡər/

common_error.wrong: If I would have time, I would go to the party.
common_error.correct: If I had time, I would go to the party.
common_error.correct_alt: If I had time, I'd go to the party.
common_error.explanation: Mabé ezali mpo na kotika 'si tendría tiempo' (kondisionali) na 'if I would have', kasi na anglais ndaku ya 'if' ta ye moko na 'would'. Na esika na yango, ozali kosala ngambo ya lokola (had). Mpo na kozala na mabé, kolinga kozua ete 'if' ezali na ngambo ya lokola (mpoko hipótesis ya oyo ezali to oyo ezali kolanda) to oyo esalemi (mpoko oyo esalemi), na 'would' ezali na ndaku ya mbalé.

levels.label: Second conditional (present/future hypotheticals)
levels.translation: Kondisionali ya liboso (hipótesis ya oyo ezali to oyo ezali kolanda)

examples.original: If I won the lottery, I would travel the world.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wʌn ðə ˈlɑːtəri aɪ wʊd ˈtrævl ðə wɜːrld/
examples.translation: Soki nakopesa mbongo mingi, nakotí na ndako ya makasi.
examples.note: Kolinga kozua ete 'won' ezali ngambo ya lokola, ta ye moko na 'ganó' na esika oyo.

examples.original: If he were taller, he could play basketball.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf hiː wɜːr ˈtɔːlər hiː kʊd pleɪ ˈbæskɪtbɔːl/
examples.translation: Soki nazali na nguya, nakoki kosala basket.
examples.note: Na anglais ya ndenge, 'were' ezali kosalema mpo na bato nionso, kasi 'was' ezali ya ndenge na anglais ya ndenge.

examples.original: What would you do if you had a million dollars?
examples.phonetic: /wʌt wʊd juː duː ɪf juː hæd ə ˈmɪljən ˈdɑːlərz/
examples.translation: Naki kosala soki ozali na mbongo mingi?
examples.note: Nteki ezali kosala lisanga ya 'would' na moto.

examples.original: If I had known, I would have come earlier.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd noʊn aɪ wʊd hæv kʌm ˈɜːrliər/
examples.translation: Soki nayebi yango, nalaki kosala yango na ntango oyo esalemi.
examples.note: Kosala oyo esalemi (had + partisipio) na 'if' na 'would have + partisipio' na mbalé.

examples.original: She wouldn't have missed the train if she had left home on time.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈwʊdnt hæv mɪst ðə treɪn ɪf ʃiː hæd left hoʊm ɒn taɪm/
examples.translation: Ye alingaki kopesa yango soki alaki kosala yango na ntango oyo esalemi.
examples.note: Ozali mpe kosala 'would not' na 'wouldn't'.

examples.original: If we had booked in advance, we would have got a discount.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː hæd bʊkt ɪn ədˈvɑːns wiː wʊd hæv ɡɒt ə ˈdɪskaʊnt/
examples.translation: Soki tokoki kosala reservation na ntango oyo esalemi, tokoki kopesa yango na ndenge oyo malamu.
examples.note: Na anglais ya nguya 'got' ezali kosalema na partisipio; na américain mbala mosusu 'gotten'.

levels.label: Wish + past models
levels.translation: Nakopesa mabé + ngambo ya oyo esalemi

examples.original: I wish I had studied more for the test.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ hæd ˈstʌdid mɔːr fər ðə test/
examples.translation: Nakopesa mabé soki nalaki kosala yango mingi mpo na examen.
examples.note: Na 'wish' + oyo esalemi komona mabé oyo esalemi.

examples.original: I wish I could speak English fluently.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ kʊd spiːk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈfluːəntli/
examples.translation: Nakopesa mabé soki nakoki kosala anglais na ndenge oyo malamu.
examples.note: Na 'could' + ngambo komona makambo oyo ozali na yango.

examples.original: I wish it weren't raining today.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ ɪt wɜːrnt ˈreɪnɪŋ təˈdeɪ/
examples.translation: Nakopesa mabé soki ta yango ezali kolanda luyo.
examples.note: Na 'wish' + oyo ezali kolanda komona makambo oyo ezali kolanda.

translations.ln: Komona mabé oyo esalemi na kosala makambo oyo ta yango

title: Discussing Advantages and Disadvantages / Kozonga yango na ntoma na bato oyo bazali na mayele
bridge: Na espanyolí, tozali kozonga yango na nsango 'ventajas' na 'desventajas' oyo ezali bato, kasi na anglais ezali pona kozala na yango na nsango 'advantages' na 'disadvantages' na lokuta oyo ezali na yango na bato oyo bazali na mayele. Kasi, na anglais tozali kozonga yango na nsango 'pros and cons' na yango oyo ezali na bato oyo bazali na mayele, oyo ezali na yango oyo ezali na bato oyo bazali na mayele. Boye, tokoki kozonga yango na nsango 'por un lado' mpo na 'for one side' – lokuta oyo ezali na yango ezali 'on the one hand'.
rule:
Pona kozonga yango na anglais na niveau B1, boye ozali kozonga yango:
1. 'One advantage (of) is that...' / 'One disadvantage (of) is that...' – na yango oyo ezali na bato oyo bazali na mayele.
2. 'The advantages of + bato/gerundio are...' pona kozonga yango.
3. 'On the one hand... on the other hand...' pona kozonga yango na bato oyo bazali na mayele.
4. 'However' to 'Nevertheless' pona kozonga yango na bato oyo bazali na mayele.
5. 'Pros and cons' ezali nsango oyo ezali na bato oyo bazali na mayele: 'Let's weigh the pros and cons.'
Boyei, ezali na bato oyo bazali na mayele oyo ezali na yango oyo ezali na bato oyo bazali na mayele: 'It has many advantages' (kasi 'advantages of').

concept_examples.text: One advantage of living in a big city is that there are more job opportunities.
concept_examples.translation: Mbeke oyo ezali na yango na bato oyo bazali na mayele ezali pona kozala na yango na bato oyo bazali na mayele.
concept_examples.phonetic: wʌn ədˈvæntɪdʒ əv ˈlɪvɪŋ ɪn ə bɪɡ ˈsɪti ɪz ðæt ðer ɑːr mɔːr dʒɒb ˌɒpəˈtjuːnɪtiz

concept_examples.text: On the other hand, the cost of living is much higher.
concept_examples.translation: Kasi, likambu oyo ezali na yango ezali pona kozala na yango na bato oyo bazali na mayele.

title: Narrating a story / Kolobela yango mbotama moke
bridge: Na espanyol, po na kolobela biso na lokola, tosilanga na ntango ndenge ya lokola moko na ya lokola moke, mpe kozonga yango ezali ya motoya. Na anglais, eloko ezali ya ndenge moko kasi na makasi oyo ezali moke: 'past simple' esalemi po na misala oyo esili, mpe 'past continuous' po na misala oyo ezalaki kozala na lokola. Molongo ya mabe ezali kopesa yango na ndenge ya lokola 'estaba + gerundio' na espanyol na anglais, kasi na anglais, tosilanga 'used to' to 'would' po na makasi oyo esili na lokola, oyo ezali na elongo ya ndenge na espanyol. Mpe boye: na anglais, 'past perfect' (had + participio) ezali ya motoya koleka 'pluscuamperfecto' na espanyol po na kozonga yango na lokola.
rule:
Po na kolobela yango na anglais na niveau B1, boye ezali na bosaleli ya ntango ya verbe oyo:
1. **Past Simple** (affirmatif: sujet + verbe na lokola, p. ex. 'walked'; négatif: 'didn't + verbe'; interrogatif: 'Did + sujet + verbe?'). Esalemi po na misala ya motindo mpe oyo esili na lokola, na kozonga.
2. **Past Continuous** (was/were + verbe -ing). Ekokisa misala oyo ezalaki kozala na lokola na mokolo moko ya lokola, mbala nyonso ekomami na ntango moko ya lokola (past simple).
3. **Past Perfect** (had + participio ya lokola). Ekokisa ntango moko oyo esili na lokola na ntango moko ya lokola. Esalemi te koleka na espanyol, kasi ezali ya motoya po na kozonga kozonga.
4. **'Used to'** (sujet + used to + verbe base) po na makasi to etat oyo esili na lokola mpe oyo ezali te na bosaleli.
5. **'Would'** po na makasi oyo esili na lokola (na lokola ya ndenge to ya liteya).
Bosaleli ya ntango: 'first', 'then', 'after that', 'suddenly', 'finally', etc. Ekoki kozonga yango.
Makasi: verbe ya mabe (go-went-gone, see-saw-seen). Boye na négatif mpe likebi, tosilanga 'did' mpe verbe na base.
Po na niveau B1, boya 'past perfect continuous' (ezali ya motindo ya zomi).

title: Arguing a point of view / Kɔbátisa mokɔlɔ mwa ngáí
bridge: Na español, po na kɔbátisa mokɔlɔ mwa ngáí tolingi kopesa míkélo ya ndakisa 'en mi opinión' to 'yo creo que', mpe mbala nyingi tokoki kobenga sujeti na ntina ya verbe oyo elobeli. Na anglais, sujeti ezali na bosɔ́li mpe tokosala lisusu ya ndakisa 'I think that...' to 'In my opinion...'. Mpe na anglais, tokosala mbala nyingi 'should' po na kopesa míkélo to conseils, kasi na español tokosala 'debería' to 'tendría que'. Boye mpe, boye mpe, tokoki kosala likambo moko ya malamu koleka 'yo pienso que' na ndakisa ya 'I think that' (ezali malamu) kasi boye mpe tokoki kobenga sujeti: 'Pienso que' = 'I think that' (kasi te 'Think that'). Likambo moko ya malamu mpe ezali kosala 'I am agree' na esika 'I agree', na ntina ya 'estar de acuerdo' na español ezali kosala 'estar' kasi na anglais 'agree' ezali verbe ya motóya.
rule:
Po na kɔbátisa mokɔlɔ mwa ngáí na anglais na niveau B1, sala lisusu oyo:

1. **Kopesa míkɛlɔ:** 'I think (that)...', 'I believe (that)...', 'In my opinion...', 'From my point of view...'. Ndakisa: 'I think that recycling is important.'
2. **Kopesa mabotami:** 'because', 'since', 'as'. Ndakisa: 'I believe we should save water because it's essential for life.'
3. **Kopesa mabotami to conseils:** 'should' + verbe ya motóya (kasi 'to'). Ndakisa: 'People should use public transport more.'
4. **Kobatela to kozonga baté:** 'I agree', 'I disagree', 'I agree with you', 'I don't agree'. Note: 'agree' ezali verbe, kasi te adjectif, boye mpe boye mpe tokoki kosala 'be + agree'. Ndakisa: 'I agree with your idea.' (Te: 'I am agree').
5. **Kobatela:** 'However', 'but', 'on the other hand'. Ndakisa: 'Some people think that, but I disagree.'

Boyoka sujeti ezali na bosɔ́li na anglais, mpe na bilóto ya ndakisa ya motóya: 'I agree' te 'Agree'. Mpe 'think' mpe 'believe' tokoki kokende na 'that' (ezali na bosɔ́li) to kokende na phrase. Po na B1, ezali malamu kopesa 'that' po na bosɔ́li.

title: Talking about your job and career / Kozonga ntalo na likambo oyo ozali kosala
bridge: Na español, tozali kosala na verbu 'trabajar' na prepozision 'de' (trabajo de médico), kasi na anglais bazali kosalaka na 'work as' (I work as a doctor) to 'be' (I am a doctor). Kosi na anglais, bazali kobondela mingi na 'work' (mot ya kopesa ntina ya mawa) na 'job' (sala ya bosolo), kasi na español tozali kosalaka na 'trabajo' na mibongo mibale. Boye, boye, tala na present simple: na español tokoki kobimisa sujet, kasi na anglais tokoki kosala bongo te.
rule:
Koyebisa ntalo na likambo oyo ozali kosala na anglais na niveau B1, sala bongo:
- Present simple koyebisa ntalo na yo oyo ozali kosala awa: 'I work as a teacher' (nazali professeur) to 'I am a teacher'.
- 'Work in' + secteur to ndako (I work in a hospital), 'work for' + société (I work for Microsoft), 'work with' + bato to biloko (I work with children).
- Koyebisa ntalo na carrière ya yo, sala na 'career' (parcours) na 'job' (sala ya bosolo). Mwa exemple: 'I'm looking for a new job' (nazali kozwa sala mosusu), 'She has a successful career' (ye azali na carrière ya bosolo).
- Koyeba makasi to makano ya mbula oyo ezali kokoka, sala na 'would like to' + infinitif (I'd like to change careers) to 'planning to' (I'm planning to look for a new job).
- Boye, boye, tala na mibeko ya kopesa ntina: 'always', 'usually', 'often', 'sometimes', 'never' koyebisa routine ya mosala.

title: Describing processes / Komona mbongo (nkani ya mwa ntina oyo ekomaki yango)
bridge: Na espanyolé, tokosala mbongo mingi na lokuta na 'se' (koti, 'se calienta el agua') to 'presente simple'. Na anglais, mbala mingi tokosala na lokuta na 'is/are + participio' (koti, 'the water is heated') na banzingi ya mbongo koti 'first', 'then', 'next', 'after that', 'finally'. Molakisi moko mpenza ezali ete na espanyolé tokoyebisa motuna te, kasi na anglais tokosala motuna na lokuta ya 'you' to 'they'. Kuna na anglais, lisolo ya biloko ezali makasi mingi: liboso motuna, sima lokuta, na sima banzingi ya ntalo bobomi liboso ya lokuta mpenza kasi na nsima ya 'be'.
rule: Komonisa mbongo na anglais na niveau B1, tokosala mingi na 'presente simple' (ya biloko ya solo) na lokuta ya mbongo (present passive: am/is/are + past participle) tango tokokani na mosala te ya oyo akosala yango. Lisolo ya solo ezali: Liboso, [kuma] is/are + past participle. Sima tokoyebisa banzingi ya mbongo: first, then, next, after that, later, finally. Tokoki kosala na lokuta ya ordre (koti na makomi) to 'you' ya solo. Lokuta ya mbongo esalemi: motuna + lokuta 'to be' + past participle. Koti: 'The coffee is ground.' Koyeba ete banzingi ya ntalo (always, usually, often) bobomi liboso ya lokuta mpenza kasi na nsima ya 'be' (koti, 'The water is always heated first'). Na anglais, tosalaka 'se' ya mbongo te; tokosala na lokuta ya mbongo na 'be' to na lokuta ya mosala na 'you'.

title: Expressing uncertainty and possibility / Komona boye mpe mosala
bridge: Na español basali subjonctif to mpe ngalasemi oyo ete 'quizás' mpe 'tal vez' po komona boye, kasi na anglais subjonctif général ezali likolo; na ndakisa basali verbes modaux oyo ete 'might' mpe 'could' to mpe ngalasemi oyo ete 'maybe' mpe 'perhaps'. Boye: 'must' ezali 'debe' po mosala te, kasi elobeli likambo oyo tolomi malamu (debe de).
rule: Po komona boye na anglais, basali: 1) Ngalasemi: 'maybe', 'perhaps', 'probably', 'definitely' (na ndaku ya libonga to sima ya sujet). 2) Verbes modaux: 'may', 'might', 'could' po mosala (may/might ezali ya kobakisa malamu; could ezali ya komiwana malamu na positif). 3) 'Must' po deduction logique: 'She must be at home'. 4) Structure 'be likely to' to 'be unlikely to' po mosala. Na négatif, basali 'might not' to 'may not' (te 'could not' po mosala, kasi 'couldn't' elobeli lokumu ya liboso).

title: Making formal requests / Libónga ya bilónga mpé salémi ya libónga ya ntama
bridge: Na español, tokotala kozonga kondisionali ('¿Podría...?', '¿Sería posible...?') kasi bilónga ya libónga. Na anglais, lokola kondisionali, ezali mpé na bosembo 'Would you mind...?' oyo ezali kolanda gerundio (-ing), oyo esili ndakisa mosúsu ya ntina na español. Boye kobima te kozonga '¿Te importaría...?' mpo na 'Would you care...?', kasi ezali kobima. Boyeka mpé ete na anglais ya libónga, 'please' ezali kozonga na nsuka to na nsunga ya verbe ya modal, te na ntama lokola na español.
rule:
Kasi kosala bilónga ya libónga na anglais (nivel B1), kozonga baninga oyo:
1. **Would you + verbe ya ntama...?** – 'Would you send me the report?' (¿Podría enviarme el informe?). Ezali ya ntina mpé ezali kozanga.
2. **Could you + verbe ya ntama...?** – 'Could you help me with this?' (¿Podría ayudarme con esto?). Ezali lokola 'Would', kasi mpé ezali ya ntina moke.
3. **Would you mind + gerundio (-ing)?** – 'Would you mind closing the window?' (¿Le importaría cerrar la ventana?). Baninga oyo ezali ya ntina mpenza mpé ezali kozanga kasi misala oyo ezali kobima. Kosolola 'No, not at all' soki ozali kobima te.
4. **I would like to + verbe ya ntama** – 'I would like to request a refund.' (Me gustaría solicitar un reembolso). Kasi kozanga bilónga na yo moko.
5. **Bilónga ya libónga na 'Would it be possible to...?'** – 'Would it be possible to reschedule the meeting?' (¿Sería posible reprogramar la reunión?). Ezali ya ntina mpenza, ezali kozanga na email.
Boyeka: na anglais, 'please' ezali kozonga na nsuka ya mobeko to na nsunga ya sujet na bilónga, te na ntama lokola na español. Ndakisa: 'Could you help me, please?' te 'Please, could you help me?'.

translations.ln: Libónga ya bilónga mpé salémi ya libónga ya ntama
